reviews.title: ASUS TUF Gaming B860-PLUS WiFi is a winner for Intel Core Ultra Plus
reviews.comment: The ASUS TUF Gaming B860-PLUS WiFi is a good motherboard for these new Intel Core Ultra Plus CPUs. I have had mine long enough to establish longevity but I have been fortunate enough to have good luck with ASUS motherboards going back to the Intel 440BX chipset. The installation was straight forward and had my Intel Core Ultra 5 250K Plus running in no time.
reviews.author: Patrick F. Sullivan

reviews.title: Nice board
reviews.comment: Working as expected and easy installation. No complaints on this unit. The magnet on the antenna is fairly strong too which is nice. The USB female port to provide the case USB C doesn't like to have the cable very stable seated in there but I have ran into that one other boards as well.
reviews.author: Daniel

reviews.title: Does not work with Intel Ultra processors
reviews.comment:
It does not work with intel Ultra
I could not get it to do anything. I found a review where he had the same issue and replaced it with a rock b860m and it worked.
I did the same and it works perfectly!
Shame as I wasted hours swapping stuff out and the self build website said it was compatible but thats not true.
4 stars because I am sure its a great mb otherwise.
I now have a great place to hide my bourbon too.
reviews.author: Eddiebezzell
